description: This dataset gives the name, address, location and unique ID of every registered general practitioner (GP) practice in Scotland. It was first supplied by GeoPlace and takes practice data from the NHS Scotland open data platform, matched to current address records in the One Scotland Gazetteer and AddressBase; it is published on the Improvement Service's Spatial Hub and listed on data.gov.uk through the Scottish spatial data catalogue. Coverage is all registered GP practices in Scotland. Access: the Spatial Hub dataset page, with the source list on Public Health Scotland's open data site. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): OGL-UK-3.0. Free. Caveats: the data.gov.uk entry was last modified in June 2024, so check currency on the Spatial Hub. Simulation uses: locating primary care facilities for hazard exposure, accessibility and emergency planning. Related records: NHS Hospitals - Scotland and healthsites.io.
